name: Tárkány (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Tárkány (a green shield with a patriarchal cross, two stags and a bunch of grapes) above a yellow scroll inscribed TÁRKÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
